newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 9.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 9.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- PHARE holds a seminar in parliament on the establishment of a health inurance programme in Lithuania.
- The European Commission ambassador Henrik Schmiegelow said that Lithuania will start talks about joining the European Union together with other associate member states.
